finding: Workflow artifact names alone are insufficient evidence because expired artifacts, duplicate names, incomplete identities, and artifacts from another workflow run can be misbound to an otherwise valid run observation.
implementation: Added a fail-closed artifact manifest gate that requires positive artifact and run identifiers, exact workflow-run binding, non-expiration, unique names, and complete presence of the required artifact set.

verification.route: dependency-free Node test suite executed against byte-identical local source before commit

limits: The gate is not yet composed into scripts/vercel-workflow-observation-pipeline.mjs.
No qualifying push or workflow_dispatch run was available through the connector.
No Vercel deployment or physical iPhone Safari audibility is proven.
